message: Hey Jane, how's everything going at Helping Hands? Heard there was a big event coming up!
Jane, thank you for the session today. It really made a difference for me.
Reminder: Community potluck this Friday at 5 PM. Bring your favorite dish!
I can't believe how much my kids enjoyed the art workshop! They haven't stopped talking about it.
Jane, I saw the pictures from the workshop, it looked amazing! You're doing great work.
The budget meeting is rescheduled to next Wednesday at 3 PM.
Don't forget to submit your ideas for the community mural project by tomorrow!
It's been too long since our last coffee catch-up. Let's plan something soon!
I'm feeling much more confident after our talk. Thanks for being there, Jane.
Volunteers needed for the community garden this Saturday!
